info.name: Grid Agent Management Available UMA Providers API

params.name: countryCode
params.description: The alpha-2 representation of a country, as defined by the ISO 3166-1 standard.

params.name: currencyCode
params.description: The ISO 4217 currency code to filter providers by supported currency.

params.name: hasBlockedProviders
params.description: Whether to include providers which are not on your allowlist in the response. By default the response will include blocked providers.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 20, max 100)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for pagination (returned from previous request)

items.docs: Retrieve a list of available Counterparty Providers. The response includes basic information about each provider, such as its UMA address, name, and supported currencies.
